profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Technical Leader | SRE | Architect | Fraud & Banking Systems
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer and Technical Leader with 15+ years of experience designing, operating, and modernizing large‑scale banking and fraud‑prevention platforms across on‑prem and cloud environments. 

Proven track record in site reliability engineering, systems architecture, DevOps automation, and ML‑enabled fraud systems, delivering measurable cost savings and SLA improvements. 

Strong bridge between business and engineering, trusted to lead global teams and mission‑critical systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical leader and senior engineer for mission-critical global fraud platforms across multiple regions.
- Responsible for system architecture design, implementation, operation a support of a complex, large-scale logical infrastructure supporting enterprise applications.
- Acted as IT Service Owner delegate, responsible for reliability, compliance, and delivery.
- Led ML-driven fraud initiatives, generating substantial annual savings and improved detection.
- Designed and automated cloud and on‑prem environments, with strong focus on resilience.
- Practiced Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to improve availability, resilience, and incident response.
- Delivered L3 production support and technical guidance across global teams.
- Implemented security scanning, audits, and remediation aligned with enterprise standards.
- Built automation using Python, Bash, Control‑M, and TOSCA, reducing manual effort.
- Supported distributed databases (DB2, Oracle) and developed RESTful services.
positions.insights: Skills: SAS (Software) · Software Infrastructure · Engineering · SRE · DevOps · LINUX · Agile · Cybersecurity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Provided senior consulting and L3 production support for Bank fraud systems worldwide.
- Coordinated multi-country engineering teams across Europe, APAC, Middle East, and the Americas.
- Designed and executed disaster recovery exercises for regulated banking platforms.
- Led OS, middleware, and application upgrades across physical, virtual, and cloud environments.
- Automated backend processes and supported global control version deployments.
- Applied SDLC, ITIL, Agile, and Scrum delivery methodologies.
positions.insights: Skills: SDLC · SAS (Software) · Software Infrastructure · Software Design
